Shohrat Issi Khabar Ki Bohat Door Door Hai

python - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
path = 'src/data/lyrics/lab-par-khusha-naseeb-mere-zikar-e-noor-hai.md'
_, meta, body = Path(path).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
blocks = lambda s: [block.strip().splitlines() for block in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', s.strip())]
r, b = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert [len(x) for x in r] == [len(x) for x in b] == [1]+[3]*7
assert all(x[0].strip() == str(i) and y[0] == chr(0x6f0+i) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(r[1:], b[1:]), 1))
assert [line.strip().casefold() for stanza in r for line in stanza if not line.strip().isdigit()] == original.strip().casefold().splitlines()
print('Verified 15 matching verse positions, stanza numbers, and original Roman wording.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 15 verses in Urdu script and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions align as one opening verse followed by seven numbered couplets. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “pa” as `پہ` and “Ibn-e-Fatah” as `ابنِ فاتح` from context.
